items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: I was close friend with Stella Oliver.

ctx.x: Did you know Dave Nelson up the country? Davidson Nelson, Dave. Supposed to be Joe Oliver's nephew, Ken Oliver's nephew. King Oliver's nephew. King Oliver, no. No, you didn't, but yeah, they might have been gone.

I'm thick, I'm thick. I was close friend with Stella Oliver. Oh yeah. Stella Oliver's niece got a son for me. Mm-hmm. Got a son for me, 35 years old. So I never heard I mentioned Joe Oliver. Joe Oliver come from Bunshire, Louisiana. Mm-hmm. That's Cross the Road from Downsville. Is that near Smoke Bend? That's Cross the Road from Smoke Bend. That's where I came from, Smoke Bend. Mm-hmm. But you said Downsville because that's the courthouse center.
